PROSE.rule: No new Prose repair transaction may be opened. If a current BOOK-owned integration subject that consumes preserved completed Prose capability fails, the defect belongs to BOOK and routes to BOOK as a Book integration failure. Historical Prose subject evidence does not create current Prose repair work.

rules: Every active repair transaction has exactly one canonical active execution owner resolved through the topology selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY.
Active repair owner systems are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS only.
PROSE is complete and terminally retired with no standalone or inherited repair lane.
BOOK receives Book lifecycle/state/orchestration/integration failures, including failures in current Book-owned integration bytes that consume preserved completed Prose capability.
DOCUMENTS owns only Documents product/document-artifact repairs and receives no Prose repair work.
Historical standalone Prose repair evidence remains immutable and transfers no PASS, repair budget or qualification authority to any changed subject.
No repair transaction may create or transfer A-01 PASS, peer promotion, canonical-writer, human, author, private, native, external, publication or production authority.
SUBJECT_FAILURE may create owner-valid product repair work; admission/window/dependency/human/author/private/native/external/control-plane outcomes route to their truthful boundary.
An active owner chat or Second Shift worker checks its repair inbox after current-authority reconciliation and before unrelated build-ahead.
Changed candidate bytes require a new exact SHA and deterministic prequalification PASS on that same SHA before A01_REQUEUE_READY.
Completed/superseded/dead-letter transactions move to history; history is never erased.
